newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy cabinet did not discuss DPEF-secretary.
newsitem.headline: Italy cabinet did not discuss DPEF-secretary.

text.p: Italy's cabinet meeting on Friday did not discuss the forthcoming three year programme of economic targets (DPEF), cabinet secretary Enrico Micheli said.
He told a news conference after the cabinet that the DPEF would probably be taken up at a meeting next week but this was not yet certain.
The eagerly awaited DPEF is expected to give indications of savings the government hopes to make from a planned reform of the welfare state.
It will also give new 1998 deficit forecasts and will be used as the basis for Italy's convergence plan to join the European single currency. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
